title: Fix median for even-length input
spec: Users report that `stats.median([1, 2, 3, 4])` returns 3 instead of 2.5. Fix `median` so even-length input returns the mean of the two middle values, and add a regression test. Do not change `mean`.
acceptance: median of an even-length list is the mean of the two middle values
a regression test covers the bug
